result: Planning stage - implementation has not yet begun.
development: The project is currently in the planning stage. Product requirements, platform architecture, resource management, learning workflows, authentication, storage, administration, and monetization models are being defined before implementation begins.
problem: Churches, ministries, and other organizations often have valuable teaching and learning materials distributed across documents, recordings, messaging platforms, and physical storage. This can make resources difficult to organize, find, protect, and reuse for structured learning.
description:
Lawrean Nexus is a planned digital learning and resource management platform being developed under the Veran product direction.

The initial focus is on helping churches and ministries organize and deliver their educational content digitally. The platform is intended to provide a centralized library for resources such as PDF documents, Word documents, spreadsheets, audio recordings, and video tutorials, while also supporting structured courses and learning programs.

Beyond simple file storage, Lawrean Nexus is planned to support organized learning experiences such as discipleship courses, assessments, automatic marking, certificates, and qualifications. The long-term vision is for the platform to become useful beyond churches and ministries, potentially supporting other institutions such as training organizations and universities.

The project is currently in the planning and product-definition stage. The architecture, subscription model, administration system, storage strategy, course structure, and other technical decisions will be developed progressively as the product moves toward implementation.
shortDescription: A digital learning and resource platform designed to help churches and other organizations manage educational content, courses, assessments, certificates, and digital resources in one place.
solution: Lawrean Nexus is planned as a centralized platform where an organization can manage its learning resources and turn those resources into structured digital learning experiences, while keeping control of its own content and users.
title: Lawrean Nexus

shortDescription: A browser-based prototype for comparing two versions of a commercial offer PDF and identifying substantive changes, discrepancies, and supporting source evidence.
result: A working document comparison tool that can analyze commercial offer revisions, identify expected changes, flag discrepancies, and provide traceable source references for its findings.
title: Lawrean Kompa
description: Lawrean Kompa is a document comparison tool designed to analyze two versions of a commercial offer PDF and identify meaningful changes between them. It extracts structured information from the documents, matches corresponding line items, compares quantities, prices, totals, delivery details, and other commercial information, and presents the differences with references back to the source documents.
technologies: React, Vite, JavaScript, CSS, Python, FastAPI, PyMuPDF, FastEmbed, NumPy
development: The system was developed with a React and Vite frontend connected to a FastAPI backend. PDF documents are processed with PyMuPDF, while semantic matching helps identify corresponding line items even when their names or ordering differ. Deterministic calculations and comparison logic are then used to verify quantities, prices, totals, and other commercial changes.
problem: Comparing revised commercial offer documents manually can make it difficult to identify every changed line item, price, quantity, total, or other important commercial detail. Small changes can easily be overlooked, especially when items are reordered or described differently between document versions.
features: PDF document comparison, Structured PDF extraction, Line-item matching, Semantic matching, Quantity and price comparison, Total recalculation, Arithmetic discrepancy detection, Source evidence references, Uncertain-match handling, Automated testing
solution: Lawrean Kompa automates the comparison process by extracting information from both PDF versions, matching corresponding line items, comparing their values, recalculating totals, and presenting detected changes together with source evidence from the original documents.

title: Arise Register
problem: Manual attendance recording during church services can make it difficult to maintain organized records, track service attendance accurately, and produce reports for different branches and services.
solution: Arise Register provides a digital workflow for managing church services and recording attendees. Users are assigned roles and branches, allowing the system to keep registration activities associated with the appropriate branch and service. Chief Ushers can set up services and monitor registrations, while ushers can focus on attendee registration during active services.
description: Arise Register is a Flutter and Firebase-based church registration and usher-management system designed to make church event registration and participant management more organized. The system provides a digital alternative to manual registration processes and helps church administrators manage registration information through a centralized application. And it was made specifically for Arise and Shine Glory ministries International
development: The application was developed with Flutter and Dart and uses Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore for user access and data management. Service records are associated with branches, while attendee registrations are associated with individual services. Firestore real-time streams are used for live registration counts, and atomic increments are used when updating service registration totals. The application also generates PDF attendance reports for selected services.stem.
features: Branch-based user access, Role-based access, Service setup and management, Attendee registration, Real-time registration counting, Attendance history, Service-specific registration records, Usher registration auditing, PDF attendance reports, Regular and special service types, Branch-specific data management
shortDescription: A church registration and usher-management system built with Flutter and Firebase to streamline member registration and event administration.
result: A digital attendance management system that gives church ushering teams a structured way to start services, register attendees, monitor attendance, review historical registration records, and generate service attendance reports.

shortDescription: A modern church website and content management system built with Astro and Firebase for Arise and Shine Glory Ministries International in Entebbe.
description: A modern, responsive church website and content management system being developed for Arise and Shine Glory Ministries International in Entebbe, Uganda. result: An extensible church website and content management platform designed to give Arise and Shine Glory Ministries International control over its changing digital content while maintaining a technically controlled, performant, and SEO-friendly public website.

title: Arise and Shine Glory Ministries International Website
